paite: Hauhsakna thupite sang in minhoih tel zawk ding ahi, dangka leh dangka-eng sang in deihsakna a-ithuai zaw hi.
Hausa leh genthei akituakkhawm ua, amaute bawl TOUPA ahi.
Mipilvang in hoih lou amu a, akibu hi. Himahleh mimawl in aphu zel a, athuakloh hi.
Kiniamkhiakna leh TOUPA kihtakna loh tak hauhsaknate, zahtakhuaina leh hinna ahi.
Lingte leh thangte mihoih lou lampi ah a-om; kuapeuh akha kem in huaite agamlat ding hi.
Apaina ding lampi ah naupang chil in, huan a-upat hun nangawn in leng huai a kipan apial kei ding hi.
Mihau in genthei tung ah vai ahawm a, huan leitawisakmi a ding in leitawimi sikha ahi.
Kuapeuh thulimlouhna tuh in tuahsia ala ding; huan ahehna chiang alohching kei ding.
Kuapeuh khuttawi lian mit nei vualzawl in a-om ding; migenthei kiang a atanghou a kipan apiak ziak in.
Muhsit hatmi delhkhia in, huan kinakna apaikhe ding hi; ahi, kisualna leh zumhuaina atawp ding hi.
Kuapeuh lungtang sianthouna it, amukte deihhuaina ziak in kumpipa alawm ahi ding hi.
Theihna nei amah TOUPA mit in avomhoih ding, himahleh lepchiahmi thute apai ahi.
Thadah in, polam ah humpinelkai a-om; kongzing ah thah in a-om ding, achi hi.
Numei lamdangte kam kokhuk thuk ahi; kuapeuh TOUPA deihloumi huai ah akelut ding hi.
Haina naupang lungtang sung ah henlop in a-om a; himahleh bawldikna chiang in amah a kipan gamlapi ah adelhkhe ding hi.
Kuapeuh apunna khansakna ding a migenthei nuaisiah a, kuapeuh mihau kiang a pia, taksapna atung lel hi.
Na bildoh inla, mipil thute za in, huan ka theihna lam ah na lungtang suk in.
heading: Thugen Pilhuai Sawmthum

paite: Na sung a na kepleh thil nuam ahi ngal a, na muk a hihkip khawm a a-omleh.
Na muanna TOUPA ah ahihtheihna ding in, tuni in na kiang ah, nang mahmah kiang ah ka theisak hi.
Thuphate leh theihna tungtang a thil hoih penpente na kiang ah ka gelh khinta kei maw.
Na kiang a thu hon dongte thutak a na dawntheihna ding a, thutak leh muanhuaite nang hon theisak hilou ka hi hiam?
Agentheih ziak in, genthei lok ke'n, kongpi ah gimthuak leng nuaisiah sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Khatna

paite: TOUPA'N lah athu uh agen sin ngal a, amau lokte hinna alok ding hi.
Mihehbaih toh kizawl ke'nla, huan thangpaihhat mi toh kithuah ke'n.
heading: Thugen Nihna

paite: Alampite na sin kha dia, na kha a ding in thang na mu kha ding hi.
Khutbengte lak a khat hi ke'nla, ahihkeileh leibate ziak a mohkhu a pangte lak a leng hi sam ke'n.
heading: Thugen Thumna

paite: Piak ding na neih keileh, bang ding a na nuai a kipan na lupna lamang ding ahia?
Na pipute koihkipsa, tang a gamgi suan ke'n.
heading: Thugen Lina

paite: Anasep a kizenmi na mu hia? Kumpipate ma ah adingh ding a; mithulimloute ma ah adingh kei ding hi.
heading: Thugen Ngana
